messages.Un instrument produce variații de presiu: An instrument creates pressure variations in the air. A microphone converts them into a signal x(t), and a note's pitch is mainly related to its fundamental frequency f₀, measured in hertz (Hz).
messages.Perioada T₀ este timpul unei oscilații c: The period T₀ is the time for one complete oscillation, in seconds. Frequency f₀ tells us how many oscillations occur in one second. A higher frequency is generally heard as a higher note.
A4: f₀ = 440 Hz, so T₀ ≈ 2.27 ms.
messages.Un sunet periodic poate conține fundamen: A periodic sound can contain a fundamental and components at whole-number multiples of it. The first harmonic is the fundamental itself; the next harmonics are 2f₀, 3f₀, and so on. Some harmonics may be very weak or nearly absent.
messages.Două instrumente pot cânta aceeași notă: Two instruments can play the same note with the same fundamental, yet have different harmonic amplitudes. This distribution, together with the sound's attack and decay, is an important part of timbre.
f₀ is measured in Hz and T₀ in seconds. For A4, 440 oscillations per second means T₀ = 1/440 s ≈ 2.27 ms.
messages.La f₀ = 440 Hz, primele componente sunt: At f₀ = 440 Hz, the first components are 440 Hz, 880 Hz and 1320 Hz. k=1 is the fundamental; the frequency of harmonic k does not tell us how strong it is.
messages.x(t) este semnalul măsurat, A₀/2 compone: x(t) is the measured signal, A₀/2 its constant component, Aₖ the amplitude of harmonic k, and φₖ its phase. The laboratory shows frequencies and amplitudes; it does not reconstruct all phase details.
messages.DFT calculează contribuția frecvențelor: The DFT calculates the contribution of discrete frequencies in N samples; FFT is the fast algorithm for the DFT. STFT repeats the calculation in successive windows: m is the frame number, H the hop between frames, and w[n] the window. fₛ is the sampling rate and N the number of samples in one window. For real audio, the positive half of the spectrum is displayed.
messages.La analiza fragmentului, N se alege adap: For fragment analysis, N is selected adaptively between 2048 and 32768; the “FFT resolution” value shows Δf.
messages.Frecvențele reprezentabile trebuie să fi: Representable frequencies must be below the Nyquist limit. A longer window reduces Δf and separates nearby frequencies better, but makes rapid changes harder to locate in time.
messages.Pentru spectrograma acestui laborator, N: For this laboratory's spectrogram, N=2048 and hop H=512 (75% overlap), so Δf=fₛ/2048 and the time between frames is H/fₛ. If fₛ=44,100 Hz, Δf≈21.5 Hz, the window lasts≈46.4 ms, and frames are spaced≈11.6 ms.
messages.Fereastra Hann atenuează marginile fragm: The Hann window tapers the segment edges and reduces spectral leakage. The spectrum shows relative amplitude: 0 dB is the highest peak in that spectrum, while −20 dB means an amplitude ten times smaller.
messages.— Transformata Fourier discretă: descomp: — Discrete Fourier Transform: decomposes a block of samples into frequency components.
messages.— Fast Fourier Transform (transformata F: — Fast Fourier Transform: an efficient algorithm for calculating the DFT; the mathematical result is the same.
messages.— Short-Time Fourier Transform (transfor: — Short-Time Fourier Transform: repeats the FFT analysis over successive windows to show how frequencies change over time.
messages.— hertz, unitatea frecvenței; 1 Hz însea: — hertz, the unit of frequency; 1 Hz means one oscillation per second.
messages.— decibel, scară logaritmică folosită ai: — decibel, a logarithmic scale used here for relative amplitude.
messages.— Musical Instrument Digital Interface;: — Musical Instrument Digital Interface; a MIDI note number encodes pitch, and n=69 corresponds to A4.
messages.— rata de eșantionare, în eșantioane pe: — sampling rate, in samples per second;
messages.— numărul de eșantioane dintr-o fereastr: — number of samples in a window;
messages.n este numărul MIDI; n=69 corespunde not: n is the MIDI number; n=69 corresponds to A4. A difference of 12 steps doubles the frequency, or raises it by one octave. The laboratory compares the detected frequency with these equal-tempered values.

messages.Trage zona colorată pentru a o muta și m: Drag the highlighted region to move it and its edges to change its duration. Or enter “Start” and “Duration”. ←/→ moves the segment; ↑/↓ changes its duration. “Reset fragment” restores the piece's default selection.
messages.La încărcarea piesei și ori de câte ori: When the piece loads and whenever you change the segment, the spectrum updates automatically. Read the detected note and fundamental, then find the spectrum peaks and compare the harmonic bars. “Reanalyze segment” manually repeats the analysis for the current selection, for example after an error.
messages.Deschide subtabul „Evoluție în timp”. Cl: Open the “Change over time” subtab. Click the spectrogram or use ←/→ to move the analyzed segment to another moment.
messages.„Piesa întreagă” prezintă spectrul mediu: “Whole piece” shows the average spectrum: it combines the frequencies found, but does not show when each note occurs.
messages.Încarcă WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG sau M4A de c: Load a WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG or M4A file up to 80 MB. The file is read locally in your browser and is not sent to a server.
messages.„Reset total” oprește redarea și revine: “Reset all” stops playback and restores the first violin demonstration, its default segment, the beginning of the piece and 80% volume.
messages.browserul poate cere un click înainte să: your browser may require a click before it allows audio. If you hear nothing, check the laboratory and device volume.
messages.Orizontală: timpul. Verticală: variația: Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axis: audio-signal variation. A repeating pattern indicates periodicity; the time between similar cycles is approximately T₀. The highlighted region is the analyzed segment, and the vertical line shows playback position.
messages.Orizontală: frecvența în Hz. Verticală:: Horizontal axis: frequency in Hz. Vertical axis: relative amplitude in dB. A peak marks a component in the segment; peaks near multiples of f₀ may be harmonics. Peak height shows amplitude, not note frequency.
messages.Orizontală: numărul armonicii k. Vertica: Horizontal axis: harmonic number k. Vertical axis: amplitude relative to the tallest bar. Tall bars mean relatively strong harmonics. Compare the bar pattern for timbre, not the overall playback volume.
messages.Orizontală: timpul în piesă. Verticală:: Horizontal axis: time in the piece. Vertical axis: frequency (0–5000 Hz). Brighter areas indicate more energy. Parallel horizontal bands are harmonics; when they move, the note changes. The white trace estimates one dominant fundamental, not every note played at once.
messages.Arată distribuția amplitudinilor pe dura: It shows the amplitude distribution over the recording using consecutive, non-overlapping FFT windows of 8192 samples. It is useful for finding frequently occurring frequencies, but averaging hides note order and changes over time.
messages.Găsește o notă stabilă și citește f₀. În: Find a stable note and read f₀. Before looking at the spectrum, calculate 2f₀ and 3f₀. Then compare your prediction with the first two harmonic peaks.
messages.f₂ = 2·440 = 880 Hz; f₃ = 3·440 = 1320 H: f₂ = 2·440 = 880 Hz; f₃ = 3·440 = 1320 Hz. The fundamental period is approximately 2.27 ms.
messages.Ascultă o piesă de corzi și una de sufla: Listen to one string piece and one wind piece. Select a stable segment from each, check the detected note and compare harmonic amplitudes. If the notes differ, compare relative distributions rather than peak heights alone.
messages.În spectrograma completă caută o bandă c: In the full spectrogram, find a band that rises or falls. Move the selection to two different moments and compare the fundamental values and detected notes.
messages.Rezoluție: ce poate distinge FFT-ul?: Resolution: what can the FFT distinguish?
messages.Δf = fₛ/N este distanța dintre binuri. D: Δf = fₛ/N is the spacing between bins. If two components are closer than the window can resolve, their peaks may merge. Use a longer segment for better frequency resolution, but you will lose precision about when a change occurs.
messages.Detectarea urmărește o fundamentală domi: Detection follows one dominant fundamental. In chords or polyphonic passages, spectrogram bands may belong to several notes, and the white trace does not separate them all. Very short attacks, vibrato, noise and audio compression can shift the estimate.
messages.Alege o notă susținută și un fragment su: Choose a sustained note and a long enough segment; listen before interpreting; check the Hz unit and each graph's axes; compare instruments on the same note and keep the volume comfortable.
